categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server implementation files (src/httpserver.cpp, src/httpserver.h).
categories.rationale: Adds unit tests and cleans up disconnection handling in the custom HTTP server following the libevent replacement. The change simplifies control flow in `ShouldDisconnect`, fixes a misleading idle timeout log, and adds mock-socket unit tests covering idle timeouts and disconnection paths.
